scope: Source-authenticated one-use terminal reference TypeError replay and own-catch continuation; physical runtime-owner recovery remains separate.

cases.purpose: Initial verification rejects before the protected return captures a successful result; repairing the cell in cleanup must not erase the pending error or cause a second finalizer entry.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v;
    try { return $v; }
    finally { echo 'F|'; $v = 'fixed'; }
}
$v = new stdClass;
try { $r =& g(); echo 'ACCEPTED'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'R'; }
echo '|', $v;

cases.purpose: A second finalizer entry repairs the captured cell, but cleanup must propagate the already pending TypeError rather than retrying the return until it succeeds.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v, $n;
    try { return $v; }
    finally {
        ++$n; echo $n, '|';
        if ($n === 1) { $v = new stdClass; }
        else { $v = 'fixed'; }
    }
}
$v = 'old'; $n = 0;
try { $r =& g(); echo 'ACCEPTED'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'R'; }
echo '|', $v;

cases.purpose: A second-pass finalizer return supersedes the saved TypeError and selects the new reference cell; it must not enter that finalizer a third time.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v, $replacement, $n;
    try { return $v; }
    finally {
        ++$n; echo $n, '|';
        if ($n === 1) { $v = new stdClass; }
        else { return $replacement; }
    }
}
$v = 'old'; $replacement = 'override'; $n = 0;
try {
    $r =& g(); echo $r;
    $r = 'changed'; echo '|', $replacement, '|', $n;
}
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'R'; }

cases.purpose: A second-pass finalizer exception replaces the pending TypeError without replaying the same finalizer for its own throw site.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v, $n;
    try { return $v; }
    finally {
        ++$n; echo $n, '|';
        if ($n === 1) { $v = new stdClass; }
        else { throw new Exception; }
    }
}
$v = 'old'; $n = 0;
try { $r =& g(); echo 'ACCEPTED'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'WRONG_TYPE'; }
catch (Exception $e) { echo 'E'; }
echo '|', $n;

cases.purpose: Both normal and exceptional cleanup traverse inner then outer finalizers. The nested ping call authenticates a saved g frame while the original captured cell remains live.
cases.source:
<?php
function ping() { echo 'P|'; }
function &g(): string {
    global $v;
    try {
        try { return $v; }
        finally { ping(); echo 'I|'; $v = new stdClass; }
    }
    finally { echo 'O|'; }
}
$v = 'old';
try { g(); echo 'ACCEPTED'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'R'; }

cases.purpose: A throw originating inside the finalizer overrides a valid protected return, so source reconstruction must not replay the finalizer containing that throw.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v;
    try { return $v; }
    finally { echo 'F|'; throw new Exception; }
}
$v = 'old';
try { $r =& g(); echo 'ACCEPTED'; }
catch (Exception $e) { echo 'E'; }

cases.purpose: The protected try's own catch remains eligible after a delayed return error; after catch cleanup, the function resumes after the try and a new reference return selects the live shared cell.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v, $n;
    try { return $v; }
    catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'C|'; $v = 'caught'; }
    finally { ++$n; echo 'F', $n, '|'; if ($n === 1) { $v = new stdClass; } }
    echo 'A|'; return $v;
}
$v = 'old'; $n = 0;
$r =& g(); echo $r;
$r = 'shared'; echo '|', $v;

cases.purpose: A delayed error from a return in an already selected catch must replay its finalizer and propagate to the caller without reopening a sibling catch.
cases.source:
<?php
function &g(): string {
    global $v, $n;
    try { throw new Exception; }
    catch (Exception $e) { echo 'C|'; return $v; }
    catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'SIBLING|'; $v = 'healed'; return $v; }
    finally { ++$n; echo 'F', $n, '|'; $v = new stdClass; }
}
$v = 'old'; $n = 0;
try { g(); echo 'ACCEPTED'; }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo 'R'; }
echo '|', $n;

<?php class C{public static object $o;}class S{function __toString(){global $v;C::$o=&$v;return 's';}}function take(string &$s){}function &g():string{global $v;try{return $v;}finally{echo 'F|';$v=new stdClass;}}$v=new S;take($v);try{g();echo 'ACCEPTED';}catch(TypeError $e){echo 'R';}echo '|',C::$o===$v&&$v instanceof stdClass?'SHARED':'DETACHED';
